name: print-social-white-maze-pattern-faq-cover-with-hand-holding-blue-ticket
title: FAQ Cover with Hand Holding a Blue Ticket
whatItIs: A white cover with a faint maze pattern, blue curved bands at the top right and the bottom, a ticket logo, a heavy headline 'Everything you've been too shy to ask about Tixpool, let's answer it.' with the last words in blue, a monochrome hand offering a blue vertical ticket and a swipe hint.
whatItMeans: A grey hand presenting a blue ticket keeps the focus on one colourful object, and the curved bands cradle it like a bowl.
techniques: Black-and-white hand with one blue object
Curved blue bands as a frame
Blue emphasis on the last words

vocabulary.definition: A hand presenting an object to the viewer.
A wide curved stripe used to frame content.
Keeping a photo monochrome except for one coloured element.
